bibl.title: Waisenfürsorger (ὀρφανοεπιμεληταί) und Fohlenbezähmer (πωλοδαμασταί) im ptolemäischen Ägypten
bibl.seg: Sandra Scheuble-Reiter, Waisenfürsorger (ὀρφανοεπιμεληταί) und Fohlenbezähmer (πωλοδαμασταί) im ptolemäischen Ägypten.
bibl.note: Presents an unpublished Ptolemaic papyrus from the collection of the University of Trier [P. Trier U.B. Inv. S 78-7, Herkunft unbekannt, 2. Jh. v.Chr.] which contains an official letter concerning a tax-collection. The papyrus is of special interest, firstly because of its unusual receipt form which requires further investigation, and secondly and primarily, however, because of its exceptional lexicography.
